freeze_basis.statement: Every clause below (surfaces, population, falsification_rule, metrics, gates, controls) is copied byte-for-byte from the accepted frozen hypothesis. Only run metadata, the freeze basis and the head-drift disclosure are new. No gate, metric, success rule or population was weakened, added or removed.
freeze_basis.why_a_new_freeze_is_required: The accepted instrument hard-pins the product head and product-file hashes in its freeze record (control C7). A measurement on the current accepted product head requires a new freeze record that pins the new head; reusing the old freeze would force a false ENVIRONMENT_OR_CONTROL_FAILURE.

question: Does the shipped product adversarial_retrieval/3 heuristic counter-signal layer reach any frozen known-counter authority on the 24-envelope cached OpenCaseLaw sample, and does it beat the frozen marker rule on the marker rule's own text surface?
primary_claim: On the offline cached product path (classifier input `full_text or regeste`; cached rows have no full_text, so regeste), the shipped counter-signal layer emits at least one admissible counter signal on at least one of the 14 frozen known-counter authorities reachable in the bundle.
product_relevance: The shipped classifier is the admission signal for the later independent LLM reviewer in apply_adversarial_pass. If it never signals a known authority, that authority cannot be preferentially admitted to the bounded reviewer set. This is a product capability measurement, not a legal-correctness judgment of the reviewer.

surfaces.offline_primary: apply_adversarial_pass fallback: full_text or regeste; cached envelopes carry no full_text
surfaces.optimistic_same_surface: title + regeste + snippet; the frozen marker rule's own text surface
surfaces.hydrated_sensitivity: product query-cache detail full_text where available; not a simulation of live top-12 hydration selection

falsification_rule.not_falsified_if: G1, G2, G5, G6, G7 all true

metrics.product_signal_n: rows where classify_against_intent returns a status and verbatim evidence
metrics.known_signalled_n: reached known-counter rows with an offline primary signal
metrics.known_marker_labelled_n: reached known-counter rows labelled by the frozen marker rule
metrics.known_optimistic_signalled_n: reached known-counter rows signalled on title+regeste+snippet
metrics.known_hydrated_n: reached known-counter rows with non-empty product-cache full_text
metrics.known_hydrated_signalled_n: hydrated reached known rows with a full_text signal

G6_every_signal_has_verbatim_evidence.rule: every product signal has a counter status and non-empty evidence

G7_pool_provenance_and_duplicate_free.rule: pool sizes match accepted run 39834312064, final pools are duplicate-free, 24 cache envelopes

controls.C1_pins_unchanged: spec, accepted record, marker record, bundle producer, hypothesis, freeze record, product files
controls.C2_cache_and_pool_parity: 24 cache envelopes unchanged; product query cache manifest unchanged; pool and marker counts match accepted run
controls.C3_product_module_identity: adversarial_retrieval/3, classify_against_intent and bundle_topic_terms present, build_answer present
controls.C4_planted_detection_and_blank_topic_vac: planted exception row signals; blank topic returns none; negative row returns none
controls.C6_deterministic_repeat: two independent measurement passes produce identical signal id sets

product_file_delta_vs_prior_freeze.product/query/answer.py: CHANGED (deterministic extractive-answer topic proxy changed; this is the only product code delta on the measured path)

head_drift_disclosure.note: This is a confirmatory head-drift replication, not a blind run. The answer.py change can alter the topic proxy used by the frozen classifier surface, so the measurement is not zero-delta; the prior published verdict is disclosed and is not re-used as this run's verdict.
